title: minuartia rubra subsp. funkii
intro: Minuartia rubra subsp. funkii, commonly known as Funk's pearlwort, is a plant species within the family Caryophyllaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing oxidative stress, and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Funk's pearlwort include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential candidate for treating various conditions, such as acne, minor wounds, and fungal infections. The bioactive constituents of Minuartia rubra subsp. funkii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
